description: Machine-readable protocol control-plane dossier: live EIP-1967 / owner / Safe reads, every controller Safe's signers and threshold, Safe signers shared with other indexed protocols (read live at the same block), and the Base EAS attestation proof. Free: 100 calls per caller per UTC day (no key, no payment); x402 USDC on Base above quota. Shares the 100/day quota of /v1/x402/dossier; above it, call that route over HTTP with x402 ($0.05). With no arguments it checks the built-in default (aave-v3-gho).

caller_agent.description: Optional identifier of the calling AI agent, IDE, or framework (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'windsurf', 'coinbase-agentkit', 'elizaos', 'langchain', 'chatgpt', 'gemini', 'openclaw', 'custom-agent'). Omitted or invalid values never block a call (inferred from known client headers or 'unspecified'). Lowercase slug only; never include personal names, emails, or secrets.

caller_purpose.description: Optional: operational workflow context for this pre-execution check (closed enum).

requester_role.description: Optional: high-level role category of the requester or system running this check (closed enum; no personal data).

slug.description: Optional protocol slug; omit for built-in Aave V3 / GHO Base-EAS dossier.
